entries.msgstr: Von Krieger taught his machines to think, because that's the only trick he knows. He really believes intelligence is what makes a human a human, despite evolution suggesting otherwise. We didn't get here by thinking first; we got here scared, hungry, and reckless. He, on the other hand, thought he could build the top floor without laying a foundation first. Fine by me, I'll knock it all down regardless. This Foudre's been to hell and back, and it's got everything I need to leave smoke where his toys used to be. Time to give the mad scientist a glimpse of what real life looks like.
Major modernization of the main battle tank
Each overloaded Generator will charge Silver Bullet with Plasma. The more Charges, the more damage Plasma causes. Shoot when the Blitzträger's shield is down for maximum damage.
